activities.activity: Sleeping through the night in the bedroom with the fan on low and the air conditioner off to save energy
Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and getting changed into work clothes for the early shift
Eating breakfast at the counter with toast, fruit and a cup of tea while checking the phone for shift messages
Commuting to the health clinic for the morning shift, walking and using public transport in the already warm morning air
Working as a health care professional, attending handover, checking patients, administering medication and updating clinical notes
Taking a lunch break in the staff room, eating a packed lunch and drinking plenty of water to stay hydrated in the heatwave
Continuing clinical duties, seeing afternoon patients, coordinating with colleagues and finishing documentation before handover
Commuting home after the shift, travelling in the hot late afternoon and picking up a few groceries on the way
Cooking a quick dinner on the induction cooker and eating it while keeping the range hood on and the kitchen light on
Taking a cool shower and changing into light casual clothes after the sweaty commute
Watching TV with the fan and only briefly the air conditioner, waiting out the evening peak air-conditioner tax before cooling the room fully
Using the computer to review study notes and plan the next shift, with the dehumidifier off and lights dimmed to keep energy use low
Washing up, brushing teeth and getting ready for bed
Sleeping for the night with the fan running and the air conditioner set to a low setting after the peak tax period ends
